The FloPlast 110mm push-fit 92.5° single socket bend in grey, is an essential uPVC pipe fitting designed for soil and vent drainage systems. This robust and lightweight bend provides a precise 92.5° angle, ideal for directing waste discharge in various plumbing installations. Manufactured from durable uPVC, it ensures strength and longevity within drainage networks. The push-fit system with ring seal joints allows for quick, secure, and reliable connections, accommodating high-temperature waste. This easy-to-install component is perfect for plumbers and drainage specialists needing efficient and secure pipework solutions. The use of silicone lubricant on all seals will facilitate jointing.
